definitions.full: H6780. tsemach צֶ֫מַח noun masculine Jer 23:5 sprout, growth ; — absolute ׳צ Hosea 8:7 +, צֶ֑מַח Zech 3:8 ; construct צֶ֫מַח Gen 19:25 +; suffix צִמְחָהּ Ezek 17:9 +; — 1 collective sprouting, growth , ׳צ הָאֲדָמָה Gen 19:25 (J), ׳צ הַשָּׂדֶה Ezek 16:7 (simile), compare Isa 61:11 ; Psa 65:11 ; so ׳צ יהוה Isa 4:2 , ׳צ absolute Hosea 8:7 ; growth (= foliage) of vine, צ ׳טַרְמֵּי Ezek 17:9 . 2 process of growth , of vine, צִמְתָהּ עֲרֻגֹת Ezek 17:10 = the beds where it grew. 3 future ruler, under figure of sprout from Davidic tree (compare Psa 132:17 ) צ ׳לְדָוִר צַדִּיק וַהֲקִמֹתִי Jer 23:5 a righteous sprout, shoot , = צ לְדָוִד ׳אַצְמִיחַ צְדָקָה 33:15 ; hence (as proper name) צ ׳עַבְדִּי Zech 3:8 , of Zerubbabel צ ׳אִישׁ שְׁמוֺ 6:12 . צַמִּים see צמם . צְמִיתֻת see צמת . below, צמם (√ of following; compare Arabic draw together , or bandage (a wound), be compact ; Late Hebrew צִמְצֵם press ; ᵑ7 Jer Palpel, Ithpalpel veil (? denominative)).
